name: @physics/scene-format
description: Scene document schema, TypeScript types, validation gate and schemaVersion migrations — the one definition of a valid scene, imported by client and server alike.
_comment: P1: this is the first package with real code, so it sets the build posture
(D30). It emits, because the ci.yml `unit` job runs the tests on Node 20 as
well as 22 — Node 20 cannot strip TypeScript, so tests run against emitted
JS via node:test with no new test-runner dependency. rootDir is the package
root (not src/) so the normative scene.schema.json, which validate.ts
imports, is emitted beside the code and resolves identically from source and
from dist; that is the only reason for the dist/src/ nesting, which the
exports map hides from every consumer.
